name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
label: Quest
description: Battle of Warsong Gulch: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance. Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.
Do not let this happen, friend! Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you bear news from Warsong Gulch, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! You've shown your worth by defending our operations in Warsong Gulch! May word of your honor spread far and wide across our lands.
